results.content:
For the second time in his presidency, Donald Trump has chosen Saudi Arabia as the destination for his first official state visit, following brief stops in Italy and the Vatican for Pope Francis’s funeral.

Trump arrived in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, on Tuesday just before 10am local time (07:00 GMT), where he was greeted by Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman.

The US president will visit Saudi Arabia, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates (UAE) from May 13 to 16, 2025. [...] After visiting Saudi Arabia, Trump travelled to Israel, where he met with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and became the first sitting US president to visit the Western Wall in Jerusalem. He then met Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas in the occupied West Bank city of Bethlehem.
